e0-context.title: Load execution context
e0-context.imperative: Read the inherited crew doctrine, project crew context and glossary, then LAUNCH_ORDER.md, PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md, MISSION_FRAME.md, and PLAN_CONVERGENCE.md. Confirm the frozen one-gate intent and four-file scope, then attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context, launch order, problem statement, mission frame, and converged plan loaded; intent and scope confirmed

constraints: Drive this plan only through an MCP server bound to this execute.json; do not use checklist-engine CLI or hand-edit engine state.

g1-implement.title: Transactional binding store: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.md from this frozen gate and dispatch one implementer. Require test-led red/green with a real multiprocessing spawn test through production handle_post_tool_use and the real registry path, deterministic unlocked mutation control, identity parity, contained checklist claim validation, recorded release compatibility, safe-reap policy, all three transactional writers, and bounded fail-open advisory locking. Wait for the durable IMPLEMENTER_RESULT and attach implementer-result status=complete.

preconditions.statement: execution context loaded and frozen gate confirmed

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: Allowed production files: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and scripts/hooks/gauge_writer_hook.py.
Allowed test files: tests/test_spine_rail.py and tests/test_gauge_writer.py.
Never reap a readable active lease by age; no lifecycle, journal, child, actor/PID, durable-root, or historical-backfill changes.
Use stdlib-only portable advisory locks with crash release, bounded acquisition, and unique same-directory temp replacement.
If the production spawn topology cannot show an unlocked lost update, return an honest scoped null; do not manufacture proof.

structural: rail binding-store helpers and claim/release/SessionStart writers
constraint: Linux green required; Windows failure record allowed
decision: transaction boundary covers locked load, safe reap, mutation, unique-temp replace @grade: settled/human · leans g1-implement,g1-review,g1-integrate
readable active leases are never age-reaped @grade: settled/human · leans g1-implement,g1-review,g1-integrate
rail owns the 1-64 ASCII alnum underscore hyphen identity allowlist @grade: settled/measured · leans g1-implement,g1-review,g1-integrate
claims require contained readable JSON checklists; releases resolve recorded targets first @grade: settled/human · leans g1-implement,g1-review,g1-integrate
24-hour missing-target grace and short named lock budget @grade: settled/inherited · leans g1-implement,g1-review,g1-integrate
evidence: final JSON parses and retains every expected entry
confidence_flags: architecture map is degraded; source confirmation is explicit and reconcile receives the map gap

g1-review.title: Transactional binding store: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill REVIEWER_HANDOFF.md from the frozen gate and fresh implementer evidence. Dispatch an independent reviewer with no authoring context to verify intent, diff, real spawn discrimination, mutation control, portable lock behavior, exact safe-reap semantics, identity parity, claim/release compatibility, four-file scope, and non-Windows tests. Wait for and attach the durable review-result.
constraints: Reviewer must be independent of implementation and must not mutate production or engine state.

g1-integrate.title: Transactional binding store: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Accept only REVIEW_RESULT verdict APPROVE. Re-run focused and full non-Windows verification yourself, enumerate the exact four-file blast radius, and confirm red/green plus mutation-control artifacts are fresh. Record Windows-specific risk separately. Flag out-of-scope findings for triage and advance only when every condition passes.

postconditions.statement: focused rail and gauge suites pass
fresh production spawn red/green and mutation-control evidence verified; exact blast radius enumerated

constraints: No Windows-only failure can mask a non-Windows regression.
